title: Checkouts, renewals and returns by month
summary: Monthly totals of checkouts, renewals and returns at one library for a period: the numbers most annual reports ask for.

parameters.prompt: the library (pick from the list Koha shows)

sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(statistics.datetime, '%Y-%m') AS 'Month',
       SUM(statistics.type = 'issue') AS 'Checkouts',
       SUM(statistics.type = 'renew') AS 'Renewals',
       SUM(statistics.type = 'return') AS 'Returns'
FROM statistics
WHERE statistics.branch = <<Library|branches>>
  AND statistics.datetime >= <<From|date>>
  AND statistics.datetime < <<To|date>> + INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(statistics.datetime, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY 1

title: Current loans by library
summary: How many items are on loan right now at each library, and how many of those are overdue.
sql:
SELECT branches.branchname AS 'Library',
       COUNT(*) AS 'On loan',
       SUM(issues.date_due < NOW()) AS 'Overdue'
FROM issues
LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.branchcode = issues.branchcode
GROUP BY issues.branchcode, branches.branchname
ORDER BY branches.branchname

title: Items never borrowed
summary: Copies at one library that have never been checked out, oldest first: candidates for weeding or promotion.

parameters.prompt: the library (pick from the list Koha shows)

sql:
SELECT items.barcode AS 'Barcode',
       biblio.title AS 'Title',
       biblio.author AS 'Author',
       items.itemcallnumber AS 'Call number',
       itemtypes.description AS 'Item type',
       items.dateaccessioned AS 'Added'
FROM items
JOIN biblio ON biblio.biblionumber = items.biblionumber
LEFT JOIN itemtypes ON itemtypes.itemtype = items.itype
WHERE items.homebranch = <<Library|branches>>
  AND COALESCE(items.issues, 0) = 0
  AND items.datelastborrowed IS NULL
  AND items.itemlost = 0
  AND items.withdrawn = 0
ORDER BY items.dateaccessioned, biblio.title

title: Most borrowed titles in a period
summary: The 50 titles checked out most often between two dates, across all libraries.
sql:
SELECT biblio.title AS 'Title',
       biblio.author AS 'Author',
       COUNT(*) AS 'Checkouts'
FROM statistics
JOIN items ON items.itemnumber = statistics.itemnumber
JOIN biblio ON biblio.biblionumber = items.biblionumber
WHERE statistics.type = 'issue'
  AND statistics.datetime >= <<From|date>>
  AND statistics.datetime < <<To|date>> + INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY biblio.biblionumber, biblio.title, biblio.author
ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1
LIMIT 50

title: Overdue items with patron contact details
summary: Every overdue loan at one library, with the patron's card number, email and phone, oldest first.

parameters.prompt: the library (pick from the list Koha shows)

sql:
SELECT borrowers.cardnumber AS 'Card number',
       CONCAT_WS(' ', borrowers.firstname, borrowers.surname) AS 'Patron',
       borrowers.email AS 'Email',
       borrowers.phone AS 'Phone',
       biblio.title AS 'Title',
       items.barcode AS 'Barcode',
       DATE(issues.date_due) AS 'Due',
       DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), issues.date_due) AS 'Days overdue'
FROM issues
JOIN borrowers ON borrowers.borrowernumber = issues.borrowernumber
JOIN items ON items.itemnumber = issues.itemnumber
JOIN biblio ON biblio.biblionumber = items.biblionumber
WHERE issues.date_due < NOW()
  AND issues.branchcode = <<Library|branches>>
ORDER BY issues.date_due

title: Collection size by library, item type and collection
summary: How many copies each library holds, by item type and collection code, and how many are on loan now.
sql:
SELECT branches.branchname AS 'Library',
       COALESCE(itemtypes.description, items.itype) AS 'Item type',
       COALESCE(ccode.lib, items.ccode) AS 'Collection',
       COUNT(*) AS 'Copies',
       SUM(items.onloan IS NOT NULL) AS 'On loan'
FROM items
LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.branchcode = items.homebranch
LEFT JOIN itemtypes ON itemtypes.itemtype = items.itype
LEFT JOIN authorised_values ccode ON ccode.category = 'CCODE' AND ccode.authorised_value = items.ccode
WHERE items.withdrawn = 0
  AND items.itemlost = 0
GROUP BY branches.branchname, items.itype, itemtypes.description, items.ccode, ccode.lib
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

title: Items without a barcode
summary: Copies that have no barcode, so they cannot be checked out at the desk.
sql:
SELECT items.itemnumber AS 'Item number',
       biblio.title AS 'Title',
       branches.branchname AS 'Library',
       items.itemcallnumber AS 'Call number',
       items.dateaccessioned AS 'Added'
FROM items
JOIN biblio ON biblio.biblionumber = items.biblionumber
LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.branchcode = items.homebranch
WHERE items.barcode IS NULL OR items.barcode = ''
ORDER BY 3, 2

title: Items without a call number
summary: Copies at one library with no call number, so patrons cannot find them on the shelf.

parameters.prompt: the library (pick from the list Koha shows)

sql:
SELECT items.barcode AS 'Barcode',
       biblio.title AS 'Title',
       biblio.author AS 'Author',
       itemtypes.description AS 'Item type',
       items.location AS 'Shelving location',
       items.dateaccessioned AS 'Added'
FROM items
JOIN biblio ON biblio.biblionumber = items.biblionumber
LEFT JOIN itemtypes ON itemtypes.itemtype = items.itype
WHERE items.homebranch = <<Library|branches>>
  AND (items.itemcallnumber IS NULL OR items.itemcallnumber = '')
  AND items.withdrawn = 0
ORDER BY items.dateaccessioned DESC

title: Lost and withdrawn items
summary: Every copy at one library marked lost or withdrawn, with the status and the date it changed.

parameters.prompt: the library (pick from the list Koha shows)

sql:
SELECT items.barcode AS 'Barcode',
       biblio.title AS 'Title',
       items.itemcallnumber AS 'Call number',
       CASE WHEN items.itemlost <> 0 THEN 'Lost' ELSE 'Withdrawn' END AS 'Status',
       CASE WHEN items.itemlost <> 0 THEN lost.lib ELSE withdrawn.lib END AS 'Reason',
       CASE WHEN items.itemlost <> 0 THEN items.itemlost_on ELSE items.withdrawn_on END AS 'Since',
       items.replacementprice AS 'Replacement price'
FROM items
JOIN biblio ON biblio.biblionumber = items.biblionumber
LEFT JOIN authorised_values lost ON lost.category = 'LOST' AND lost.authorised_value = items.itemlost
LEFT JOIN authorised_values withdrawn ON withdrawn.category = 'WITHDRAWN' AND withdrawn.authorised_value = items.withdrawn
WHERE items.homebranch = <<Library|branches>>
  AND (items.itemlost <> 0 OR items.withdrawn <> 0)
ORDER BY 6 DESC

title: New acquisitions in a period
summary: Copies added to one library's collection between two dates, newest first.

parameters.prompt: the library (pick from the list Koha shows)

sql:
SELECT items.dateaccessioned AS 'Added',
       items.barcode AS 'Barcode',
       biblio.title AS 'Title',
       biblio.author AS 'Author',
       items.itemcallnumber AS 'Call number',
       itemtypes.description AS 'Item type',
       items.price AS 'Price'
FROM items
JOIN biblio ON biblio.biblionumber = items.biblionumber
LEFT JOIN itemtypes ON itemtypes.itemtype = items.itype
WHERE items.homebranch = <<Library|branches>>
  AND items.dateaccessioned BETWEEN <<From|date>> AND <<To|date>>
ORDER BY items.dateaccessioned DESC, biblio.title

title: Records with no items
summary: Catalogue records that have no copies attached, newest first.
sql:
SELECT biblio.biblionumber AS 'Record number',
       biblio.title AS 'Title',
       biblio.author AS 'Author',
       biblio.frameworkcode AS 'Framework',
       biblio.datecreated AS 'Date created'
FROM biblio
LEFT JOIN items ON items.biblionumber = biblio.biblionumber
WHERE items.itemnumber IS NULL
ORDER BY biblio.datecreated DESC

title: Titles with more holds than copies
summary: Titles where waiting holds outnumber the copies that can fill them: the list to buy more copies from.
sql:
SELECT biblio.title AS 'Title',
       biblio.author AS 'Author',
       h.holds AS 'Holds',
       COALESCE(c.copies, 0) AS 'Copies',
       ROUND(h.holds / NULLIF(c.copies, 0), 1) AS 'Holds per copy'
FROM (
    SELECT reserves.biblionumber, COUNT(*) AS holds
    FROM reserves
    WHERE reserves.found IS NULL
    GROUP BY reserves.biblionumber
) h
JOIN biblio ON biblio.biblionumber = h.biblionumber
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT items.biblionumber, COUNT(*) AS copies
    FROM items
    WHERE items.itemlost = 0 AND items.withdrawn = 0 AND items.notforloan = 0
    GROUP BY items.biblionumber
) c ON c.biblionumber = h.biblionumber
WHERE h.holds > COALESCE(c.copies, 0)
ORDER BY (h.holds - COALESCE(c.copies, 0)) DESC, 1

title: Holds waiting for pickup
summary: Holds on the hold shelf at one library, with how long each has waited and when it expires.

parameters.prompt: the library (pick from the list Koha shows)

sql:
SELECT reserves.waitingdate AS 'Waiting since',
       DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), reserves.waitingdate) AS 'Days waiting',
       reserves.expirationdate AS 'Pickup by',
       borrowers.cardnumber AS 'Card number',
       CONCAT_WS(' ', borrowers.firstname, borrowers.surname) AS 'Patron',
       biblio.title AS 'Title',
       items.barcode AS 'Barcode'
FROM reserves
JOIN borrowers ON borrowers.borrowernumber = reserves.borrowernumber
JOIN biblio ON biblio.biblionumber = reserves.biblionumber
LEFT JOIN items ON items.itemnumber = reserves.itemnumber
WHERE reserves.found = 'W'
  AND reserves.branchcode = <<Library|branches>>
ORDER BY reserves.waitingdate

title: Outstanding charges by patron
summary: Every patron who owes money, how much, and the date of their oldest unpaid charge, largest first.
sql:
SELECT borrowers.cardnumber AS 'Card number',
       CONCAT_WS(' ', borrowers.firstname, borrowers.surname) AS 'Patron',
       categories.description AS 'Category',
       branches.branchname AS 'Library',
       SUM(accountlines.amountoutstanding) AS 'Owed',
       DATE(MIN(accountlines.date)) AS 'Oldest unpaid charge'
FROM accountlines
JOIN borrowers ON borrowers.borrowernumber = accountlines.borrowernumber
LEFT JOIN categories ON categories.categorycode = borrowers.categorycode
LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.branchcode = borrowers.branchcode
WHERE accountlines.amountoutstanding > 0
GROUP BY borrowers.borrowernumber, borrowers.cardnumber, borrowers.firstname, borrowers.surname,
         categories.description, branches.branchname
ORDER BY 5 DESC

title: Payments collected in a period
summary: Money collected between two dates, by library and payment type: for reconciling the cash desk.
sql:
SELECT branches.branchname AS 'Library',
       COALESCE(accountlines.payment_type, '(not recorded)') AS 'Payment type',
       COUNT(*) AS 'Payments',
       -SUM(accountlines.amount) AS 'Total collected'
FROM accountlines
LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.branchcode = accountlines.branchcode
WHERE accountlines.credit_type_code = 'PAYMENT'
  AND (accountlines.status IS NULL OR accountlines.status <> 'VOID')
  AND accountlines.date >= <<From|date>>
  AND accountlines.date < <<To|date>> + INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY branches.branchname, accountlines.payment_type
ORDER BY 1, 2

title: New patrons in a period
summary: How many patrons joined between two dates, by library and patron category.
sql:
SELECT branches.branchname AS 'Library',
       categories.description AS 'Category',
       COUNT(*) AS 'New patrons'
FROM borrowers
LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.branchcode = borrowers.branchcode
LEFT JOIN categories ON categories.categorycode = borrowers.categorycode
WHERE borrowers.dateenrolled BETWEEN <<From|date>> AND <<To|date>>
GROUP BY branches.branchname, categories.description
ORDER BY 1, 2

title: Patrons by library and category
summary: How many patrons each library has in each category, split into current and expired memberships.
sql:
SELECT branches.branchname AS 'Library',
       categories.description AS 'Category',
       SUM(borrowers.dateexpiry >= CURDATE() OR borrowers.dateexpiry IS NULL) AS 'Current',
       SUM(borrowers.dateexpiry < CURDATE()) AS 'Expired',
       COUNT(*) AS 'Total'
FROM borrowers
LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.branchcode = borrowers.branchcode
LEFT JOIN categories ON categories.categorycode = borrowers.categorycode
GROUP BY branches.branchname, categories.description
ORDER BY 1, 2

title: Patrons whose membership expires soon
summary: Patrons whose membership expires within the next N days, with contact details, soonest first.

parameters.prompt: how many days ahead to look, e.g. 30

sql:
SELECT borrowers.cardnumber AS 'Card number',
       CONCAT_WS(' ', borrowers.firstname, borrowers.surname) AS 'Patron',
       categories.description AS 'Category',
       branches.branchname AS 'Library',
       borrowers.email AS 'Email',
       borrowers.dateexpiry AS 'Expires'
FROM borrowers
LEFT JOIN categories ON categories.categorycode = borrowers.categorycode
LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.branchcode = borrowers.branchcode
WHERE borrowers.dateexpiry BETWEEN CURDATE() AND CURDATE() + INTERVAL <<Days ahead>> DAY
ORDER BY borrowers.dateexpiry, borrowers.surname
